mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at the Verona Area High School with a temperature of 40 degrees.

Regarding city news, the Verona Police Department has reported the arrest of a school bus driver for O W I on Thursday, while residents are reminded that zoning ordinances and updated polling locations for upcoming elections can be found on the city website.

We have a full slate of activities starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by a busy tomorrow featuring trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.
On Thursday, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver near the intersection of Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace for O W I, with no injuries reported to the students on board.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM to serve you until 10:00 PM.
